content_block_gaps.truth_boundary: These gaps are measured against the pages present when the contract last ran. This builder runs before the publish step in the daily cycle, so a page published later in the same run is measured on the next cycle rather than this one. Over-listing is safe; a route named here is never a route that does not exist.

blocks.named_stop: NOT APPLICABLE TO THIS REPO. The 913 recommendations behind this spec were collected across a portfolio whose other members publish technical and advisory content, where a copy-ready prompt is the artifact a reader reuses. Porch & Party publishes event-decor and porch-styling answers for Memphis homeowners; there is no prompt for a reader to copy, and emitting one on 109 decor pages would be scaffolding of exactly the kind the template-share ceiling and the fabricated-content rules exist to prevent. Retired by flag rather than deleted: the block stays in the spec and the detector stays live, so the day this repo does publish a copyable prompt the flag below fails and the entry is reinstated. Reinstate by setting applies_to_repo true and adding an emitter to templates/page-shell.js.
